name: Typefully
summary: Collaborative writing and scheduling tool for X, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky, with AI features.
description: Typefully is a social media editor and scheduler for X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Threads. It supports team collaboration with comments, analytics, automations and AI writing features. The company reports more than 10,000 customers.

howToUse.title: Open Typefully
howToUse.description: Open Typefully and sign up to the social media editor.

howToUse.title: Write with AI
howToUse.description: Draft a post in the editor and use the AI writing features to brainstorm, rewrite, or expand it.

howToUse.title: Collaborate and schedule
howToUse.description: Use team collaboration: leave comments, then use the scheduler for X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, or Threads.

howToUse.title: Read analytics
howToUse.description: Review analytics on the published post, then set automations for the next one.
